Class LoyaltyTierLog

java.lang.Object
models.LoyaltyTierLog
public class LoyaltyTierLog extends Object
Represents an audit log entry recording a loyalty tier change for a guest in the MIRAGE system.

Every time a guest's loyalty tier is updated via GuestDAO.updateLoyalityTier(), a LoyaltyTierLog record is automatically written to capture the previous and new tier values, along with the date of the change. This provides a full audit trail of tier progressions for each guest.

Database mapping: loyalty_tier_log table.

  • Constructor Details

    • LoyaltyTierLog

      public LoyaltyTierLog(int guestId, String oldTier, String newTier)
      Creates a new LoyaltyTierLog entry capturing a tier transition. changedDate is automatically set to today's date. logId is left at 0 until the record is persisted and the key is set via setLogId(int).
      Parameters:
      guestId - the ID of the guest whose tier changed; must be positive
      oldTier - the previous loyalty tier; e.g. "Standard", "Silver"
      newTier - the new loyalty tier; e.g. "Gold", "Platinum"
